articles.title: India seals BrahMos missile deal with Vietnam, eyes Indonesia next
articles.summary: India has finalized a deal to supply BrahMos missiles, jointly developed with Russia, to Vietnam, marking a significant milestone in its defence exports. This move strengthens India's role as a defence partner in Southeast Asia. Additionally, India is in the final stages of negotiating a similar agreement to provide the supersonic cruise missiles to Indonesia, further expanding its strategic defence outreach.

articles.title: Psychic Soldiers, Mind Readers, and Dolphin Drones: The Cold War's Weird Paranormal History
articles.summary: The Russian Ministry of Defense's official magazine, Armeiiskii Sbornik, featured an article in its February 2019 issue titled 'Supersoldiers for the Wars of the Future.' The article reportedly discusses claims related to developing advanced soldiers, suggesting future military capabilities. While specific details are truncated, the focus appears to be on enhancing human performance for combat, a topic of ongoing interest in defence strategy and modernization.

articles.title: Zelensky cheers Ukraine drone strikes on Putin's planes, missiles and oil industry deep into Russian territory
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky celebrated successful overnight drone strikes deep inside Russian territory. These attacks targeted aircraft, missile depots, and critical oil facilities, reportedly causing fires at Putin's energy infrastructure. The strikes underscore Ukraine's evolving long-range capabilities and sustained efforts to disrupt Russia's war machine and logistics amidst the ongoing international conflict.
